source.name: Footy Headlines: 'Haiti 2026 World Cup Home, Away & Third Kits Released'
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense. Footy Headlines' official launch coverage (updated 2 Apr 2026) describes every mark on the home shirt — blue and white with a red collar and white trim, a graphic of silhouettes of Haiti's independence heroes raising the national flag on the lower right torso, the motto 'L'union fait la force' and the royal palm tree — and its launch photos show the shirt front and back: no commercial sponsor on any placement. ColombiaOne (8 Apr 2026, colombiaone.com/2026/04/08/saeta-haiti-world-cup-kit-2026/) describes the same design and Saeta's thirteen-year kit supply to Haiti, with no commercial sponsor mentioned. The design was later modified at FIFA's request over its historical imagery before the tournament (Daily Sabah, 11 Jun 2026); only the graphic changed, and Saeta sells the shirt itself (saetasport.com, 'Camiseta Oficial Haití').
source.quote: Colombian sportswear brand Saeta has officially unveiled the Haiti 2026 World Cup kits

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: Saeta's 2026 World Cup home shirt (blue and white, red collar, graphic of independence heroes raising the flag, the motto 'L'union fait la force' and the royal palm) carries only the Saeta logo and the Haiti crest; the launch coverage's description and photos show no commercial sponsor on any placement.
